purpose: A full-field lattice of 52 two-hand dials. The centre 4 by 6 block composes the HH and MM digit strokes; everything else parks dim on the south-west diagonal. Perfectly still between minutes.

night.recipe: The ghost hands and the plate flip with the palette; the lit strokes stay the accent.

options.intent: 24 is the default; 12 parks the leading-zero block for hours one to nine.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not add idle motion between minute steps
antiPatterns.why: at rest it is perfectly still by decision; the sweep exists only for the hands that change

antiPatterns.rule: Do not replace the junction-gap digit font
antiPatterns.why: the gaps are the font's character, asserted by the geometry test

specless: A lattice of dials; its geometry lives in strokes-geometry.ts.
